implementation_families.name: Odd-multiplier equality preimages
implementation_families.proof: Invert an odd coefficient modulo 2^N, including nonzero targets.

implementation_families.name: OR with modular negation zero
implementation_families.proof: x | -x is zero iff x is zero.

implementation_families.name: Isolated lowest bit zero
implementation_families.proof: x & -x is zero iff x is zero, including the sign bit.

implementation_families.name: Triangular and odd-factor shift zero
implementation_families.proof: Positive constant shifts: triangular XOR/OR or an odd modular factor; never shift zero.

implementation_families.name: Byte-permuted zero observations
implementation_families.proof: Byte reversal preserves zero.

implementation_families.name: Rotated zero observations
implementation_families.proof: Rotations are fixed-width permutations.

implementation_families.name: Population-count zero observations
implementation_families.proof: No set bits iff input is zero.

implementation_families.name: Affine-equivalent select observations
implementation_families.proof: Normalize both arm preimages, not their different integer values.

implementation_families.name: Full population count
implementation_families.proof: All N bits set iff popcount is N.

implementation_families.name: Leading-zero boundary
implementation_families.proof: Count zero iff the high bit is set.

implementation_families.name: Trailing-zero boundary
implementation_families.proof: Count zero iff the low bit is set.

implementation_families.name: Shifted zero intervals
implementation_families.proof: Replace a right-shift zero observation with an unsigned interval.

implementation_families.name: Shifted upper intervals
implementation_families.proof: Replace the extreme right-shift bucket by an unsigned threshold.

implementation_families.name: Left-shift zero masks
implementation_families.proof: Only the low N-k bits affect zero after a left shift.

implementation_families.name: Complemented mask observations
implementation_families.proof: Move bit complement into the demanded constant.

implementation_families.name: Unsigned quotient zero
implementation_families.proof: x/d==0 iff x<d, d nonzero, before magic-division expansion.

implementation_families.name: Population-count input bound
implementation_families.proof: Each set bit contributes at least one, so popcount(x)<=x unsigned.

implementation_families.name: Shared binary equality cancellation
implementation_families.proof: Cancel shared Add/Sub/XOR operands for Eq/Ne only, no no-wrap assumptions.

implementation_families.name: Shared unary equality cancellation
implementation_families.proof: Cancel matching bijections, not ordered comparisons.

implementation_families.name: Shared rotate equality cancellation
implementation_families.proof: Cancel identical rotations, including common variable counts.

implementation_families.name: Byte-swap Boolean conjugation
implementation_families.proof: A byte permutation commutes with bitwise Boolean algebra.

implementation_families.name: Byte-swap whole-byte shift conjugation
implementation_families.proof: Reverse shift direction only for constant whole-byte shifts.

implementation_families.name: Byte-swap select conjugation
implementation_families.proof: Cancel arm/output permutations without deleting condition evaluation.

implementation_families.name: Remainder-invariant low-bit demand
implementation_families.proof: If 2^k divides d, low k bits of x%d equal those of x, even for non-power-of-two d.

policy: Groups intentionally combine direction, operand-order, width and polarity variants; coverage remains limited per upstream report.
